text: In October 1994, film students Heather, Mike and Josh hike into the forest near Burkittsville, Maryland, to make [a documentary about the legend of the Blair Witch|origin|old beliefs and legends]. After [Josh knocks over a cairn in an old graveyard|trigger|unsealing what was shut away], they hear sticks snapping each night, lose their map and [walk in circles back to the same river|rules|trapped with no way out]. Then Josh vanishes, and Heather finds [a bundle of twigs holding his bloodied teeth|images|plants, trees and fungus].
